text:
nina: FYI — MedSync (healthcare customer) wants a catalog onboarding lane that guarantees embedding schema stability + a short-term pin for 6 months, plus a reproducible rerank benchmark. They want clear migration steps if we deprecate. thoughts?
omar: Can you clarify "embedding schema stability"? do they mean vector dimension & tokenizer behavior must not change, or the embedding model outputs must be bit-for-bit stable?
nina: They want both deterministic dims (no surprise dim changes) and a documented migration path for quality deltas. Not expecting bit-for-bit across model upgrades, but they need an eval showing delta < 3% on their re-ranking metric.
tyler: 3% delta tolerance is fine. Tech constraints: to guarantee dims we enforce schema contract in the catalog metadata and block model swaps that change dims without a migration plan. For latency SLOs we should ask for target qps.
jena: They also asked for a 95th pctl latency <= 120ms at 500 qps for text->embedding->rerank roundtrip. That's ambitious on hosted; probably Dedicated or a pinned cache layer required.
ops-bot: Canary run queued: rerank-harness v2 -> canary in staging at 2025-09-01T14:00Z
omar: Proposal: create a "stability lane" in the catalog with the following features: 1) contract metadata (embed-dim, tokenizer, preproc) 2) mandatory preflight: customer prompt set + rerank metric run 3) pin option (6mo by default) with an opt-in extended pin (12mo) for extra fee 4) deprecation notice: 90d standard / 180d paid.
marta: Legal: cap migration assistance to scoped professional services. We'll need to surface that in onboarding checklist. Also audit logging for embeddings access.
tyler: Operationally: add a migration harness that computes per-query delta and aggregated AUC/Recall@k. Example command for the customer to run locally:
```bash
# run rerank harness locally against our SDK bundle
python -m redwood.rerank_harness \
  --endpoint=https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  --input=medsync_prompts.json --k=10 --runs=3 \
  --collect-metrics=recall@10,auc --output=medsync_results.json
```
jena: For caching/warmth: we can provide a pre-warm window (48h) before cutover and an optional reserved cache tier. That reduces cold-start spikes but increases cost. estimate: reserved-cache +20% on top of hosted.
omar: Risk: customers will expect pin to be free. propose pricing: pin 6mo = +25% on top of standard model cost, 12mo = +40%, migration-assist hourly PS or fixed credit.
marta: I'll draft contract wording: "stability lane pinning is a paid add-on. Migration assistance limited to agreed scope; any additional work billed at standard PS rates."
ops-bot: Alert: rerank-harness v2 failed unit tests on staging. Tagging @tyler to investigate.
tyler: Investigating failing test — looks like tokenizer edge-case. Will patch today.
nina: Okay action list: tyler patch harness + add embed schema metadata checks, omar to write product PRD for "stability lane" + pricing, jana (jena?) to confirm SLO language (jena apologies if name mix), marta to draft legal clause. Let's meet Mon 11am for final sign-off.
omar: I'll also add an opt-in rollout flow: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback on rerank regression > 2%.
marta: Suggest adding a one-time migration credit to sweeten the deal for enterprise customers.
nina: Great — I'll create the spec doc in the handbook and ping sales for prelim commercial interest. Thanks all.
